title: MySQL: Update capabilities
description:
Add indication of new MariaDB MARIADB_CLIENT_BULK_UNIT_RESULTS.
Set CLIENT_SECURE_CONNECTION by default (this mostly affects
the same Login command in which it's sent, but also affects
Change User commands. Support has been universal since 4.1 to
the point that MySQL now marks this bit as Reserved2, even though
it's still set.)

Update comments for capabilities and version string.

Move creating the initial connection data to a static function.
Eventually the configuration of the initial data should depend
on preferences. (#19856).
